caseName: Western Union Telegraph Co. v. New Jersey
caseNameFull: Western Union Telegraph Co. v. New Jersey
attorneys: John H. Waters and William G. H. Acheson for appellants. Theodore D. Parsons, Attorney General of New Jersey, and Joseph A. Murphy, Assistant Attorney General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Appeal from the Supreme Court of New Jersey.

Per Curiam:

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for the want of a substantial federal question.

Mr. Justice Black and Mr. Justice Reed are of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted.
